title: File:Naphamethinidon, Naphaphonphumisiri near summit of Doi Inthanon.jpg
claims: The image shows the two chedis near the summit of Doi Inthanon: a purple-tiered chedi with a gold spire on the left, a smaller brown chedi farther right, and a terraced garden with a pool and loop paths in the foreground.

The Commons description names the chedis Naphamethinidon and Naphaphonphumisiri near the summit of Doi Inthanon, matching the organiser's Twin Royal Pagodas; the file has no bibs, timing mats, aid tables or course markers.

The author is Lester Mathias Andersson; the file is CC BY-SA 3.0; the photograph was taken on 2012-12-09; the original is 4,795 x 3,197 pixels and 15,407,112 bytes; the author credits a day trip around Doi Inthanon.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 166,034 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source.
